description: Writing-focused ChatGPT/Codex Skills for file-backed novel planning, writing, continuation, revision, import, style, and evidence-based review, with confirmation-driven orchestration and reusable continuity gates.
release_notes: Generalized continuity checks for time, place, action ownership, objects, devices, and real-world procedures.
Stronger dialogue-response, limited-viewpoint, suspense-order, and concrete-chapter-hook checks.
Optional pacing guidance for multi-threaded serialized stories.
Added separate English and Chinese package documentation.
Added a derived import-decomposition case without redistributing the source novel.
